START.text: You find yourself in a forest. There is a path to your left that leads to the ocean. On the right there is a cave

ocean path.text: The rush of the sea fills your ears. You reach the edge of the clearing. The ocean looks very inviting. Do you want to swim?

swim END.text: You jump in and the ocean is cool. Suddenly, a current pulls you away. You fight it but it is no use. The rocks are getting closer. BANG. You head bashes into the rocks. Everything fades to black.

sun bathe END.text: You spend all day lounging in the sun. You leave the beach and head home, happy and content.

cave path.text: The air cools as you get closer to the cave. Are you sure this is worth it?

gold END.text: You walk into the cave. Sitting inside is a treasure chest full of gold! You're rich!
